# Helvety PDF

> Helvety PDF merges, reorders, rotates, and extracts pages in the tab. Add images where supported. Work stays in the browser and is not sent to a conversion API. Engineered, designed and made in Switzerland.

## Canonical URL
- [Helvety PDF](https://helvety.com/pdf): Main PDF application route

## Crawling And Indexing
- The public PDF application route is intended to be crawlable and indexable.

## Related Helvety Apps
- [Helvety](https://helvety.com)
- [Helvety Store](https://helvety.com/store/products)
- [Helvety Image Editor](https://helvety.com/image-editor)
- [Helvety OCR](https://helvety.com/ocr)

## Licensing
The helvety.com monorepo is released under AGPL-3.0-or-later. Separately distributed Helvety product repositories may use different open-source licenses, including MIT, so always check the LICENSE file in the specific repository or release source link.
